overview: Despatch: Grummon reports plans for thirteen Manchuria aviation beacons starting near Dairen, and April 1935 military air maneuvers with bombing practice and low-altitude stunts.

subfiles.title: Despatch from Grummon on new air beacons and air maneuvers
subfiles.from: Stuart E. Grummon, American Consul at Dairen
subfiles.to: Joseph C. Grew, American Ambassador to Japan
subfiles.about: Reports plans for aviation beacons in Manchuria and military air maneuvers over the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Grummon reports a planned Dairen aviation beacon, part of thirteen across Manchuria, and April maneuvers with about thirty aircraft, bombing practice, and stunt flying.

interest: Shows planned Manchuria aviation beacons alongside conspicuous Japanese military air maneuvers near Dairen.
